arguments.text: A FormulaInfo document: blocks, each closed by the end mark line or by the end of input
One FormulaInfo: leading comment/blank lines, then key:value entries, then ---END_OF_PART--- (or end of input)
A comment or blank line before the first entry of a block
A line of spaces, tabs, VT and FF only
key:value. The key is a Java class name (dotted identifiers); the value may span lines
The value of an entry: the rest of the key line and its continuation lines
A value line: not KEY: at column 0 and not starting with ---END_OF_PART---
The end mark line ---END_OF_PART---, optionally followed by spaces and tabs
